hook_line: BLACKSTONE'S NEXT $50 BILLION IN INDIA WILL GO BEYOND OFFICES AND MALLS

hook_stat.sub: Blackstone's planned India exposure in five years

stats.label: Blackstone investment already in India today
Real estate portfolio that built Blackstone's India name

diaspora_bullets: The next $50 billion targets healthcare, financial services, travel and digital infrastructure
Blackstone opened a Bengaluru global capability centre, its first outside the United States
news_summary: Blackstone plans to double its India investments to $100 billion over the next five years, spreading the next $50 billion beyond offices and malls into infrastructure, private credit and growth investing.
payoff: Currency depreciation is the biggest headwind for foreign investors in India, Gray said.
